title: Implement API Authentication
problem_statement: Web API endpoints lack authentication/authorization, exposing agent orchestration to unauthorized access
risk_if_unaddressed: Critical security vulnerability allowing unauthorized agent execution and data access
suggested_approach: Implement JWT-based authentication with role-based access control for agent operations
success_criteria: All API endpoints require valid authentication tokens
Role-based permissions for different agent operations
Audit logging for all authenticated requests

title: Replace File-Based Storage with Transactional Database
problem_statement: JSON file-based storage lacks ACID properties, backup, and concurrent access protection
risk_if_unaddressed: Data corruption, loss of team/tenant data, race conditions in multi-agent scenarios
suggested_approach: Migrate to PostgreSQL with proper schema, transactions, and backup strategy
success_criteria: All team data stored in relational database with ACID guarantees
Concurrent access handling with proper locking

provenance.evidence: Direct JSON file manipulation without safeguards

title: Implement Circuit Breaker Pattern for Agent Orchestration
problem_statement: High coupling through 386 import edges creates cascade failure risk when individual agents fail
risk_if_unaddressed: Single agent failure cascading to entire pipeline, reducing system reliability
suggested_approach: Implement circuit breaker pattern with agent health checks and graceful degradation
success_criteria: Agent failures isolated and don't cascade to other agents
Health monitoring for all agents with automatic recovery
Graceful degradation when subset of agents unavailable

title: Add Comprehensive Error Handling and Logging
problem_statement: Agents lack consistent error handling patterns and structured logging for debugging
risk_if_unaddressed: Difficult debugging, silent failures, poor observability in production
suggested_approach: Implement structured logging with correlation IDs and consistent exception handling
success_criteria: All agents use structured logging with correlation IDs
Consistent exception handling patterns across all modules

provenance.evidence: JSON and datetime imports suggest logging intent but no structured implementation

title: Implement Configuration Management
problem_statement: No evidence of environment-specific configuration management or secrets handling
risk_if_unaddressed: Configuration drift between environments, hardcoded secrets, deployment inconsistencies
suggested_approach: Implement environment-based configuration with secrets management integration

provenance.evidence: Basic config file without environment handling
